apps.subtitle: Variant: no plugins
apps.localizedDescription:
## What's New

**Works with Twitch 32.1.** Updated to run on the latest Twitch app.

**Blocked the "update Twitch" nag.** Twitch 32.x added a new update prompt that could pop up and interrupt you. It's now automatically dismissed.

**Fixed Home launch screen on Twitch 32.x.** The "Home → Following", "Home → Live", and "Home → Clips" launch screen options now work correctly on Twitch 32 and newer.

**Fixed "Go Ad-Free" button hiding on Twitch 32.x.** The declutter toggle to hide the Go Ad-Free button works again on the latest Twitch version.

## Downloads

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `tv.twitch-32.1-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.22.ipa` | Sideload IPA (AltStore / SideStore / TrollStore) |
| `tv.twitch-32.1-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.22-no-plugins.ipa` | Sideload IPA without app extensions (fewer app ID slots) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.22_iphoneos-arm.deb` | Jailbreak .deb (rootful) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.22_iphoneos-arm64.deb` | Jailbreak .deb (rootless) |
